The Wither did more than strike — it radiated a plague.
The Wither Blight (Wither Effect) spread into the air, the water, the soil.
Villagers who touched it began to change:
blue skin, clouded eyes, veins like those of the Wither.
Worst of all — the dead rose again.
The Builders hid in their basements —
They were quick. Redstone detection networks warned them in time.
Villagers sealed themselves inside their homes —
oak doors shut, glass in the windows, iron golems standing guard.
Outside lay a blue haze of the Wither.
